description: Invalidate one dedicated approver key immediately; use gate_list_approvers to find its id. Requires the project owner key or an admin member key. A missing or already revoked id returns an error. To restore access issue a new key with gate_create_approver; to revoke a team member use gate_manage_members.

admin_key.description: The project owner key (ga_...) or an admin member key (gm_...). Never print it.

approver.description: The dedicated approver id from gate_list_approvers; not a member id or key.

project_id.description: The project id from gate_create_project, e.g. p1a2b3...

name: gate_revoke_approver
title: Revoke an approver key
